newsitem.title: USA: Data General sells $212.75 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Data General sells $212.75 mln debentures.

text.p: Data General Corp said Wednesday it has completed the sale of $212.75 million of its six percent convertible subordinated debentures.
The notes are convertible into common stock of Data General at a conversion price of $26.194 per share at any time before maturity in 2004, the information technology comnpany said.
Of the net proceeds, $23 million were used to retire Data General's 8-3/8 percent sinking fund debentures due 2002, it said.
The balance will be used to fund the expansion of the company's AViiON and CLARiiON businesses, fund new product development and expand distribution channels and for general corporate purposes.
